title: TC-TIB-021 — [Regression] Edit-save other GO types via Edit page unaffected
steps:
Preconditions: Staging portal; existing Global Options of other types (e.g. text, clipart-category, photo)

  1. Open an existing Global Option of type text (or clipart-category/photo/maps/json-list) on its Edit page
  2. Make a small change (e.g. rename, or tweak a setting)
  3. Save
expectedResult: Data saves identically to before this ticket — edit-save now goes through API validation instead of a direct DB write, but the saved result is unchanged for valid data (dev-flagged as the biggest regression risk of this ticket).
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com.

Observed (direct): Opened existing Global Option id 969, type "Single-line Text" ("New Single-line Text option"), via /global-options/969/edit. Changed the Global Option Name field to "New Single-line Text option - QA edit TIB-5467" (no other field touched), clicked Save. No error shown. Reloaded the page (hard navigation) and the renamed value persisted: "New Single-line Text option - QA edit TIB-5467" — confirming the save actually went through (not just an optimistic UI update).

Conclusion (direct observation): Edit-save of a non-Additional-Option Global Option type via the Edit page works correctly after this ticket's change to route edit-save through API validation — same data saved and persisted exactly as expected, no regression observed for this type/case. This is the dev-flagged "biggest regression risk" and it is not reproducing on this build.

Note: left this GO's name changed on staging (id 969) — see final report for cleanup data left behind.
